setup: A right spherical triangle has one right angle, and two of its other parts are given.

steps.say: In a right spherical triangle the Napier rules link the five remaining parts, so any two of them fix the rest.
The rule for the hypotenuse is cos c = cos a cos b, and the rule for an oblique angle is cos A = cos a sin B.
An inverse cosine returns the angle in degrees, and when both oblique angles are given their sum follows by plain addition.
